subject: Lumina Health — next steps: economic buyer, PO routing, and invoice timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Lumina Health — discovery recap & asks (econ buyer, security, PO path)

Jordan / Priya — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and requests to keep momentum: 

1) Decision criteria: you said reliability under 150ms p50, 99th percentile latency under 600ms for interactive triage use cases, and an initial focus on 5M tokens/month. I captured that in the attached one-pager (Lumina_SOW_v1.pdf). Please flag any inaccuracies.

2) Economic buyer: you mentioned the Director of Clinical Ops will sign off. Can you confirm the name and whether they need a one-pager for finance?

3) Procurement & onboarding: we need to know Lumina's vendor intake owner and PO routing. Suggested options: (a) PO to RedWood Inference AP (US), (b) Net-30 via procurement portal, or (c) customer will use a PO with an invoice sent to payables@redwoodai.com. Which aligns best?

4) Timeline: your goal was production pilot in Q3. What internal dates should we target for SOW final, PO issuance, and access (dev key)?

I've attached a draft SOW and a short vendor-intake spreadsheet to speed procurement (vendor-intake-form.xlsx).

Next steps I propose: Jordan, confirm econ buyer name and procurement contact by Wed 5/5; Priya, confirm whether security will want a SOC2 artifact or a short architecture diagram; I’ll follow up with our finance and onboarding docs and loop in Marissa for PO routing.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@luminahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@luminahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumina Health — discovery recap & asks (econ buyer, security, PO path)

Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful. Quick answers: 

- Econ buyer: Claire Dalton (Director, Clinical Ops) — claire.dalton@luminahealth.com. She prefers a 1-page ROI summary for finance and a short pilot success criteria doc.

- Procurement: procurement@luminahealth.com is the intake mailbox. They require a completed vendor intake form and a W-9. Typical PO lead time is ~3 weeks after intake approval.

- Security: Priya here — we will need your SOC2 Type II report and a network diagram. We may also request data flow and retention details. Can you confirm where we can get those artifacts?

Timeline: If we submit intake this week, PO could be issued by 5/24, access shortly after that — aligns with your Q3 pilot plan but we'd like to lock an access date by end of May.

Appreciate the attachments — will circulate internally and get back with Claire + procurement contact.

-Jordan

Jordan — great, thanks. Short answers to the security/technical asks below so procurement has what they need up front: 

- SOC2 Type II: yes, we can provide our SOC2 report under NDA. I'll attach a redacted copy to the Hub link (shared in related_links).
- Network diagram & data flow: attached short architecture diagram and a two-paragraph note on retention and encryption. Key point: customer data is isolated per-tenant; default retention 30 days for raw prompts (configurable), and at-rest encryption with customer KMS option for Private/Dedicated deployments.
- W-9: attached vendor-intake-form.xlsx includes tax/legal fields; I'll also send a separate W-9 to procurement if requested.

Karthik — FYI on procurement timeline; can you confirm what billing entity we should ask Lumina to reference on the PO (Redwood Inference LLC vs Redwood Labs Inc) and whether our AP team can accept Net-30 on initial pilots?

I'll draft a one-page ROI and a short pilot playbook for Claire and loop you in for technical acceptance criteria.

Thanks — Vanessa

Marissa
